First release of pi-yt: play your YouTube library from Pi through the YouTube session already open in your browser. yt-dlp reads your library and mpv plays the audio, so pi-yt never talks to YouTube itself.

## Highlights

- **`/yt` overlay** with Recommended, History, Watch later, Liked videos, Playlists, the queue and search on the left and their tracks on the right.
- **Your browser's session**: Firefox, Zen, Chromium, Chrome, Brave and Helium profiles, or no account to only search. Cookies are read by yt-dlp only, never copied or stored.
- **Playback with mpv**: play all, shuffle, queue, seek and volume, with full mouse support.
- **Status line** with the playing track in Pi's status bar, or in Gentle Shell's sidebar, even after the overlay is closed.
- **Guided setup**: when yt-dlp or mpv is missing, `/yt` installs the official yt-dlp release, verified by SHA-256, and explains how to install mpv. It also offers yt-dlp updates.

## Getting started

Requires Pi on Node.js 24 or newer and mpv.

```sh
pi install npm:pi-yt
```

In Gentle Shell, run `gentle-shell install npm:pi-yt`. Then run `/yt` and pick the browser where you are signed in to YouTube.

[Documentation](https://github.com/heohlee/pi-yt/blob/v0.1.0/README.md)
